title: SAP Finance Project Manager
description:
Job Title: SAP Finance Implementation Project Manager
Location: Nashville, TN
Employment Type: Contract (9 months with ability to extend)

Job Overview:
We are seeking an experienced SAP Project Manager to lead the implementation of a new SAP company code as we migrate from our legacy Oracle system to SAP ECC. This is a critical leadership role requiring proven project management expertise, strong knowledge of SAP Finance implementations, and the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver a successful migration on time and within budget.
The ideal candidate will bring deep SAP project experience with a focus on Finance modules, demonstrated ability to manage complex system integrations, and the leadership skills to guide technical and business teams through a full implementation lifecycle.
Key Responsibilities & Duties:

Project Leadership & Governance
  • Lead all aspects of the SAP Finance implementation project from initiation through post-go-live support
  • Develop comprehensive project plans, including scope, schedule, budget, resource requirements, and risk management strategies
  • Establish project governance framework, including steering committee meetings, status reporting, and escalation procedures
  • Define project milestones, deliverables, and success criteria; track progress and ensure accountability
  • Manage project budget and resource allocation, identifying and addressing variances proactively
  • Chair regular project team meetings, workstream reviews, and status update sessions

Stakeholder Management
  • Serve as primary point of contact for project stakeholders across Finance, IT, and business units
  • Facilitate executive steering committee meetings and provide clear, concise project updates
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment on project scope, timelines, and deliverables
  • Build strong relationships with business leaders to ensure buy-in and active participation
  • Coordinate with external vendors, consultants, and implementation partners as needed

Team Coordination & Management
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional project team including SAP Architect, ABAP developers, functional analysts, and business users
  • Clearly define roles, responsibilities, and deliverables for all team members
  • Foster collaboration between technical teams (SAP, ABAP, infrastructure) and business stakeholders
  • Provide guidance and direction to ensure team members stay focused on project objectives
  • Facilitate conflict resolution and remove roadblocks that impede team progress

Implementation Management
  • Guide the team through all project phases: Blueprint, Realization, Final Preparation, Go-Live, and Support
  • Oversee requirements gathering sessions and ensure business needs are clearly documented
  • Monitor configuration activities and integration development to ensure alignment with requirements
  • Manage the change control process, evaluating scope change requests for impact and approval
  • Coordinate testing activities including integration testing, user acceptance testing, and performance testing
  • Lead cutover planning and execution, including data migration, reconciliation, and go-live activities

Integration & Interface Management
  • Oversee the design and implementation of interfaces between SAP and third-party systems, particularly the billing system interfacing with SAP FI-AR
  • Ensure integration points between FI/CO and MM-Procurement are properly planned and tested
  • Coordinate with application teams managing upstream/downstream systems
  • Track interface development progress and manage dependencies between systems

Risk & Issue Management
  • Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks throughout the implementation lifecycle
  • Maintain risk and issue logs with clear ownership, mitigation plans, and resolution timelines
  • Escalate critical issues to steering committee with recommended courses of action
  • Implement contingency plans when risks materialize

Change Management & Communication
  • Develop and execute project communication plan for all stakeholder groups
  • Coordinate training strategy and ensure end users are prepared for go-live
  • Support organizational change management activities to drive user adoption
  • Document lessons learned and facilitate knowledge transfer to support organization

Qualifications & Experience:
  • Bachelors Degree in computer science, engineering, business or equivalent experience required
  • Project Management certification preferred
  • Proven experience leading at least 2 full-cycle SAP Finance implementations from blueprint through go-live
  • Experience managing SAP ECC projects is required. Managing S/4HANA projects is a plus but not required
  • Demonstrated experience managing system migration projects
  • Experience facilitating business process workshops and requirements gathering sessions
  • Knowledge of data migration tools and methodologies (LSMW, Migration Cockpit, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of financial business processes including Record-to-Report, Order-to-Cash, and Procure-to-Pay
  • Expert proficiency with project management tools (MS Project, JIRA, Smartsheet, or similar)
  • Strong risk management and issue resolution capabilities
  • Excellent budget management and resource planning skills
  • Proven ability to manage scope, prevent scope creep, and handle change requests effectively Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to work in a multicultural environment and a good English command is required

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Support cutover planning and execution, including reconciliation processes

Project Delivery & Collaboration
  • Partner with Project Manager to develop detailed project plans, timelines, and resource requirements

  • Strong understanding of financial business processes including Record-to-Report, Order-to-Cash, and Procure-to-Pay

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to work in a multicultural environment and a good English command is required
